Jordan / Marissa — tagging in the technical details you asked for. Short version up top, details below.

Recommendation: Start with Hosted (fastest) to validate quality, then spin up a Dedicated sandbox for throughput and isolation tests mid-P1 if results look promising. Reserve VPC only if policy/compliance requires it.

Dedicated sandbox estimate (trial config):
- GPU profile: 1 x A10G or equivalent per 8 concurrent inference workers (can scale to 2 x A40 for higher throughput)
- Throughput: baseline config target ~150-200 rps sustained for batch sizes optimized by our runtime; p99 latency target ~350-450ms depending on prompt length.
- Concurrency: we recommend starting with 50 concurrent virtual users for simulating production mix (we'll tune after the smoke test).

Hosted notes:
- Isolation: data stored in trial namespace, logs separated by account id; KV/prefix caching scoped to your tenant for the trial to avoid cross-tenant cache leakage. We can also wipe caches between runs.
- Pros: fastest onboarding (same-day).
- Cons: less representative of dedicated resource contention and networking (no peering).

VPC notes:
- Requirements: VPC peering, static egress IPs, firewall rules, and an encrypted peering tunnel for control-plane callbacks.
- Timeline: typical 7-14 business days depending on security review; expedite possible with SOC2 artifacts and a short technical questionnaire.

Instrumentation we'll provide:
- Per-request trace ids, token-level billing, per-route latency histograms, embedding vectors download for offline eval.
- Retention: trial logs retained for 90 days; longer retention available as an add-on.

Ask: Jordan/Sanjay — share expected peak concurrent sessions and a sample prompt length distribution (avg tokens in / out) so we can pre-size.
